entry.title: Awesome Homematic Updates on Jun 17 - Jun 23, 2019
entry.content:
Mobile Apps

  • @home - iOS - (💵 inApp-Purchase um Werbung zu entfernen)

CCU Alternatives

  • Homegear - Free and open source program to interface your smart home devices with your home automation software or your own scripts.

CCU Addons

  • hm-tools (⭐26) - Sammlung von Tools für OpenCCU.
  • RedMatic (⭐530) - Node-RED als Addon für die Homematic CCU3 und OpenCCU. Liefert u.A. komfortable HomeKit-Integration und spezielle Nodes zur Anbindung der CCU an MQTT mit.

Interfacing Software

  • node-red-contrib-ccu (⭐69) - Node-RED Nodes for the Homematic CCU.

Misc Software

  • check_homematic (⭐6) - Nagios/Icinga Plugin for checking Homematic CCU.
  • hm-simulator (⭐3) - Simulates (partly) a Homematic CCU.
  • hmcfgusb - Utilities to use the HM-CFG-USB(2) on Linux/Unix.
  • homematic-manager (⭐197) - Manage homematic interface processes (rfd/hs485d/homegear).
  • language-homematic (⭐5) - Adds syntax highlighting and snippets to HomeMatic Script files in Atom.

Software Modules

  • binrpc (⭐15) - Xmlrpc_bin protocol client and server Node.js module.
  • hm-discover (⭐7) - Node.js module to discover Homematic CCUs and interfaces.
  • homematic-rega (⭐8) - Node.js Homematic CCU ReGaHSS Remote Script Interface.
  • homematic-xmlrpc (⭐7) - Xmlrpc client and server Node.js module.
  • pmatic (⭐35) - Python API for Homematic. Easy to use.

Smart Home Software supporting Homematic

  • ioBroker - via hm-rpc (⭐61) (Interface-Prozesse) und hm-rega (⭐43) (ReGaHSS) Adapter, hmip (⭐31) für den Homematic IP Cloud Access Point.
